title: The Case for AI-Enabled Gate Monitoring as Farm Security in the UK: A PRISMA-Guided Review of the Evidence on Rural Crime, Livestock Predation and Farm Access
abstract: arXiv:2611.13933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Farm security in the UK rests on thinner evidence than its cost suggests. We ran a PRISMA guided review: twelve searches of Web of Science and Scopus on 2nd -4th November 2026 returned 1,183 records (761 unique), and grey-literature and hand-searches added 35 assessed sources. We synthesised 96 database records and 24 grey sources narratively. UK peer-reviewed evidence is small (16 records), and the main UK survey of crime and farmer mental health has 80 responses. Cost estimates rest on insurer claims: NFU Mutual put UK rural crime at {\pounds}41.5 million in 2025, with livestock theft up almost 30% to about {\pounds}4.5 million and dog attacks on livestock costing {\pounds}1.95 million. The Home Office states that agricultural crime cannot be separately identified in its central data. translated_title: 英国采用AI赋能门禁监控作为农场安全的论证：一项基于PRISMA的农村犯罪、牲畜捕食与农场通道证据综述
translated_abstract: 英国农场安全所依据的证据比其成本所暗示的要薄弱。我们进行了一项PRISMA指导的综述：2026年11月2日至4日在Web of Science和Scopus上进行了十二次检索，共返回1,183条记录（761条唯一记录），灰色文献和手工检索又增加了35个评估来源。我们以叙述性方式综合了96条数据库记录和24个灰色文献来源。英国的同行评审证据很少（仅16条记录），而英国主要的犯罪与农民心理健康调查仅有80份回复。成本估算依赖于保险公司的理赔数据：NFU Mutual估计2025年英国农村犯罪损失为4,150万英镑，其中牲畜盗窃案上升近30%至约450万英镑，狗袭击牲畜造成195万英镑损失。内政部表示其中央数据无法单独识别农业犯罪。我们没有发现针对摄像头、传感器、追踪器或标记技术的独立评估；在系统性研究中，灯光和声音威慑装置在一至五个月内便失去了效果……
tldr: 本文通过PRISMA系统性综述发现英国农场安全的证据基础薄弱、农村犯罪损失高昂（2025年达4,150万英镑）且现有安防措施缺乏独立有效性评估，从而论证了采用AI赋能门禁监控作为英国农场安全方案的必要性。
en_tdlr: This PRISMA-guided review reveals the thin evidence base for UK farm security, quantifies substantial rural crime costs (£41.5 million in 2025), and argues for AI-enabled gate monitoring as a farm security solution.
